name: Stop
description: You must come to a complete stop and give way to all traffic. Only proceed when safe.

name: Yield
description: You must give way to traffic on the road you are entering. Slow down and stop if necessary.

name: No Parking
description: Parking is not allowed at any time in this area.

name: No Stopping
description: No stopping is allowed at any time, even briefly.

name: No U-Turn
description: U-turns are not permitted in this location.

name: No Left Turn
description: Left turns are not permitted at this location.

name: No Right Turn
description: Right turns are not permitted at this location.

name: No Entry
description: Entry is prohibited. Do not proceed in this direction.

name: No Vehicles
description: No vehicles of any kind are allowed to proceed in this direction.

name: No Motor Vehicles
description: Motor vehicles are not permitted on this road.

name: No Motorcycles
description: Motorcycles and motor scooters are not allowed on this road.

name: No Goods Vehicles
description: Goods vehicles are not permitted on this road.

name: No Buses
description: Buses are not allowed on this road.

name: No Minibus Taxis
description: Minibus taxis are not permitted on this road.

name: No Animal-drawn Vehicles
description: Animal-drawn vehicles are not allowed on this road.

name: No Bicycles
description: Bicycles are not permitted on this road.

name: No Pedestrians
description: Pedestrians are not allowed on this road.

name: Speed Limit 20
description: Maximum speed of 20 km/h is permitted in this area.

name: Speed Limit 30
description: Maximum speed of 30 km/h is permitted in this area.

name: Speed Limit 40
description: Maximum speed of 40 km/h is permitted in this area.

name: Speed Limit 60
description: Maximum speed of 60 km/h is permitted in this area.

name: Speed Limit 80
description: Maximum speed of 80 km/h is permitted in this area.

name: Speed Limit 100
description: Maximum speed of 100 km/h is permitted in this area.

name: Speed Limit 120
description: Maximum speed of 120 km/h is permitted in this area.

name: End of Speed Limit
description: The speed restriction has ended. Normal speed limits now apply.

name: Minimum Speed 40
description: Minimum speed of 40 km/h must be maintained on this road.

name: No Overtaking
description: Overtaking other vehicles is not permitted in this area.

name: End of No Overtaking
description: The no overtaking restriction has ended. Overtaking is now permitted.

name: Proceed Straight
description: You must proceed straight ahead in this direction only.

name: Turn Left
description: You must turn left at this intersection.

name: Turn Right
description: You must turn right at this intersection.

name: Straight or Left
description: You may proceed straight or turn left.

name: Straight or Right
description: You may proceed straight or turn right.

name: Left or Right
description: You must turn either left or right. Straight ahead is not permitted.

name: Keep Left
description: Keep to the left side of the road or obstacle.

name: Keep Right
description: Keep to the right side of the road or obstacle.

name: Roundabout
description: You must go around this roundabout in the direction shown.

name: Curve Right
description: The road curves to the right ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to steer right.

name: Curve Left
description: The road curves to the left ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to steer left.

name: Double Curve
description: The road has two curves ahead in opposite directions. Reduce speed and be cautious.

name: Winding Road
description: The road winds with multiple curves ahead. Reduce speed significantly.

name: Steep Descent
description: A steep downhill slope is ahead. Use a low gear and brake carefully.

name: Steep Ascent
description: A steep uphill slope is ahead. Use low gear and be prepared for slower traffic.

name: Uneven Road
description: The road surface is uneven or rutted. Reduce speed and be cautious.

name: Bumps
description: Speed bumps or humps are ahead. Reduce speed before crossing.

name: Slippery Road
description: The road surface is slippery. Reduce speed and increase following distance.

name: Loose Gravel
description: There is loose gravel on the road. Be careful with steering and braking.

name: Crossroad
description: A cross intersection is ahead where traffic crosses your path. Be prepared to stop.

name: T-Junction Ahead
description: A T-junction is ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared for cross traffic.

name: T-Junction Right
description: A T-junction with traffic from the right is ahead.

name: T-Junction Left
description: A T-junction with traffic from the left is ahead.

name: Y-Junction
description: A Y-junction is ahead. Keep to your lane and be prepared to give way if required.

name: Staggered Junction
description: A staggered junction is ahead where side roads are not aligned. Be cautious.

name: Railway Crossing Unguarded
description: An unguarded railway crossing is ahead. Stop, look, and listen before crossing.

name: Railway Crossing Guarded
description: A guarded railway crossing is ahead. Obey the signals and barriers.

name: Traffic Lights Ahead
description: Traffic lights are ahead. Be prepared to stop if the light is red.

name: Pedestrian Crossing
description: A pedestrian crossing is ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to stop for pedestrians.

name: School Zone
description: You are approaching a school. Reduce speed and watch for children.

name: Cyclists Likely
description: Cyclists are likely in this area. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

name: Road Narrows
description: The road ahead becomes narrower. Be prepared to adjust your driving.

name: Two-way Traffic
description: Two-way traffic ahead. You may be on a road where traffic has been one-way.

name: Dead End
description: The road ahead ends in a dead end. Turn around or prepare to reverse.

name: Low Clearance
description: There is low clearance ahead (bridge or overhang). Tall vehicles may not fit.

name: Falling Rocks
description: Rocks may fall onto the road from cliffs ahead. Be alert and reduce speed.

name: Slippery When Wet
description: The road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce speed in rainy conditions.

name: Fog Likely
description: Fog is likely in this area. Use headlights and reduce speed if visibility is poor.

name: Flooding
description: This area is prone to flooding. Do not cross flooded roads.

name: Road Works
description: Road construction or maintenance is ahead. Reduce speed and follow signs.

name: Lane Closed
description: A lane is closed ahead due to construction. Be prepared to change lanes.

name: Flagman
description: A flagman is directing traffic ahead. Obey their signals.

name: Cattle Crossing
description: Cattle may cross the road ahead. Reduce speed and be prepared to stop.

name: Wild Animals
description: Wild animals may cross the road. Be alert, especially at night.

name: Horses
description: Horse riders or carts may be on the road ahead. Reduce speed and be cautious.

name: Hospital
description: A hospital is located in this direction.

name: Parking
description: Parking is available in this direction.

name: Police Station
description: A police station is located in this direction.

name: Petrol Station
description: A petrol or fuel station is located in this direction.

name: Restaurant
description: A restaurant is located in this direction.

name: Telephone
description: A telephone is located in this direction.

name: First Aid
description: First aid facilities are located in this direction.

name: Accommodation
description: Accommodation is available in this direction.

name: Camping
description: A camping site is located in this direction.

name: Caravan Park
description: A caravan park is located in this direction.

name: Viewpoint
description: A scenic viewpoint is located in this direction.

name: Tourist Info
description: A tourist information centre is located in this direction.

name: National Route
description: This is a national route marker. Follow these routes for main thoroughfares.

name: Regional Route
description: This is a regional route marker. These connect regional towns and cities.

name: Metropolitan Route
description: This is a metropolitan route marker within a city or urban area.

name: One Way Right
description: This is a one-way road. Traffic must proceed in the direction shown (right).

name: One Way Left
description: This is a one-way road. Traffic must proceed in the direction shown (left).
